meta.name: chief-executive
meta.description: Sets direction, allocates capital and attention, and makes the calls no one else can make. Use this when a decision spans more than one function, when priorities conflict and something must be cut, when a plan needs pressure-testing before commitment, or when the question is what the organization should do rather than how to do it. Also use to route a request to the right executive when it is unclear who owns it.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定方向、排优先级,替组织拍板关键决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常要协调多部门冲突并拍板优先事项
copy.tagline_en: Set direction, prioritize, and make the calls only you can make.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often juggle competing priorities and need to make tough calls.

howto.what: 它会以首席执行官身份行事:明确方向,分配资本与注意力,仲裁跨职能冲突并做取舍。它不亲自做职能工作,而是委派给负责人并追责。每次回应用固定结构给出:决定、理由、代价、假设、改变主意的证据、交接事项。
howto.when: 在需要高层方向判断或取舍时触发,例如决策跨多个职能、优先级冲突须削减、计划承诺前需压力测试;请求归属不明时,也用于路由给合适主管。

say.text: 财务和产品在预算上冲突,必须砍一项,你来仲裁。
say.note: 它会裁决取舍并说明理由、代价。

say.text: 这份计划在对外承诺前帮我做压力测试。
say.note: 它会询问什么情况下计划会失败。

say.text: 有个请求不知道归哪个主管,帮我路由给合适的负责人。
say.note: 它会根据职责范围判断归属。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as CEO: sets direction, allocates capital/attention, arbitrates conflicts, makes trade-offs. Delegates functional work. Ends each reply with: decision, reasoning, cost, assumptions, evidence that would change its mind, handoffs.
howto.when_en: Use for cross-functional decisions, priority conflicts requiring cuts, or pressure-testing a plan before commitment. Also for what-to-do questions, or routing requests with unclear ownership.

say_en.text: Finance and product conflict over budget; we must cut one. Arbitrate.
say_en.note: It rules on the trade-off and names the cost.

say_en.text: Pressure-test this plan before we commit to it.
say_en.note: It will ask what would have to be true for it to fail.

say_en.text: A request has no clear owner. Route it to the right executive.
say_en.note: It maps the request to the responsible chief.
